summary: The divergence is resolved. JavaScript now runs the source-matched themed post-level hook after makelevel fills special rooms, then lets the later topology finalizer perform bound_digging and mineralize. Direct #wizloaddes finalization no longer invokes the hook or re-wallifies the loaded map. Fresh C/JavaScript replay matches all 32 screens, 4218 RNG calls, and 32 cursors.

source.branch: C mklev.c:makelevel calls themerooms_post_level_generate after filling every special room; mklev.c:mklev then calls level_finalize_topology. In contrast, wizard wizcmds.c:wiz_load_splua resets, loads, and directly calls sp_lev.c:lspo_finalize_level, whose topology pass does not call the theme hook. The JS finalizer incorrectly makes that call conditional on the persistent _luathemes_loaded[dnum] flag, so a later wizard des-file load re-wallifies its map.
callers: C: mklev.c:makelevel fills special rooms at lines 1414-1418 and calls themerooms_post_level_generate at line 1420; mklev.c:mklev calls level_finalize_topology after makelevel at lines 1586-1589.

C: wizcmds.c:wiz_load_splua calls lspo_reset_level(NULL), load_special(), and lspo_finalize_level(NULL) at lines 388-390; sp_lev.c:lspo_finalize_level calls level_finalize_topology at line 6055 without themed postprocessing.

JavaScript: cmd.js dispatches wiz_load_splua to js/wizcmds.js:wiz_load_splua, which calls lspo_reset_level, load_special, then lspo_finalize_level; js/mklev.js:lspo_finalize_level calls level_finalize_topology.

JavaScript: js/mklev.js:makelevel finishes the room fills at line 898 but defers the theme hook to level_finalize_topology at lines 900-901; level_finalize_topology runs it and full-map wallification at lines 8026-8033.
dependencies: C mklev.c:themerooms_post_level_generate is the source for the JS themed postprocess and subsequent wallification. It is called from makelevel after room filling, not from level_finalize_topology or sp_lev.c:lspo_finalize_level.

The wizard command's branch condition is wizard mode. The offending JS branch additionally requires game._luathemes_loaded[game.u.uz.dnum] to remain true from earlier level generation; the recorded #wizloaddes input follows an initialized game and loads baalz.lua into that same game state.

Upstream nethack-c/upstream/src/mklev.c:1174-1193 shows the themed hook runs its post_level_generate callback and wallifies the full map. mklev.c:1414-1420 calls it after the common special-room fill loop. mklev.c:1544-1574 contains bound_digging, mineralize, topology updates, and no themed-room call; mklev.c:1586-1589 calls that function after makelevel.

Upstream nethack-c/upstream/src/wizcmds.c:376-391 routes #wizloaddes through reset, load, and lspo_finalize_level(NULL). Upstream sp_lev.c:6055-6059 calls level_finalize_topology before filling special rooms and contains no themerooms_post_level_generate call.

The JS condition is js/mklev.js:8026-8035: if _luathemes_loaded[dnum] it runs run_themeroom_postprocess and wallification before mineralize. js/mklev.js:898-902 fills special rooms but defers the hook to the shared topology finalizer. Because the wizard special-level command enters the same finalizer while the theme-loaded flag persists, the ordinary makelevel hook is repeated against the just-loaded Baalz map.

An isolated replay trace shows the repeated full-map wallification exposes 13 additional eligible STONE cells at x=77, y=5..17 to mineralize. The extra mineralization draws occur before C's next place_lregion call and account for the first RNG divergence; the remaining changed wall glyph accounts for the first screen divergence.

Implementation commit c9edd3a00e7192709862265e812dbed7931959d1 adds the mklev.js themerooms_post_level_generate helper and calls it from makelevel after all special-room fills on each generation return path. It removes themed postprocessing and wallification from level_finalize_topology. This keeps the ordinary source ordering from mklev.c:1414-1420 and leaves sp_lev.c:lspo_finalize_level NULL finalization without a second theme pass.
